title: Large graphs of diameter five from a duality of order four of the split Cayley hexagon H(9)
description: Quotients of incidence graphs of generalized polygons by polarities are a classical source of large graphs of given maximum degree and diameter. The construction needs less than a polarity: if a connected bipartite graph has diameter n, its quotient by any group of automorphisms containing an element that interchanges the two parts has diameter at most n − 1. The split Cayley hexagon H(9) has no polarity, but it has dualities of order four. We show that any two of them generate conjugate subgroups of the automorphism group of its incidence graph, and that the quotient by such a duality has 33397 vertices, of which 33033 have degree 10, 336 have degree 7 and 28 have degree 6, and diameter 5. Adding edges and twin vertices we obtain N(10, 5) ≥ 33397, N(11, 5) ≥ 35203 and N(12, 5) ≥ 38167 for the degree-diameter problem, the previously published lower bounds were 14047, 20952 and 34992. For the other symplectic quadrangles W(2h) and split Cayley hexagons H(3h) whose incidence graphs have degree at most 20, the quotient by a duality of minimal order does not improve the known bounds.
